basic_profile.bio: I'm a car enthusiast from Chicago, diving into the world of car modifications. I've always loved tinkering with cars and recently got my hands on a 2004 Infiniti G35 coupe. I work as a junior mechanic at a local garage, which fuels my passion for cars. When I'm not working, I'm usually online in the evenings after work. I'm currently single and enjoy spending my weekends at local car meets or browsing through Reddit for inspiration and advice.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid foundation in car mechanics, having studied automotive technology at a community college. Most of my practical knowledge comes from working on cars in the garage and learning from more experienced mechanics. I also spend a lot of time watching car-related content online, which helps me stay updated with the latest trends.
